_about: Hand-kept tables for the kit page (ledger M295), read by ismail/kit.py. The Sound Engineer gardens them: a row per public voice (family, type, engine, modeled_on: an instrument type, never a brand; ear: untested|pending|usable|passed|failed with exam: the exam id, file or ledger row that judged it, and heard: what was heard), a row per effect type, and the open gaps per family. After an edit run python -m ismail.kit to regenerate docs/KIT.md and docs/kit.json.

types.sampled: plays real recorded notes or hits (a sample set fetched on the person's word)
types.measured: a code model (waveguide, modal, additive) whose numbers were fitted to recordings
types.mimic: a profile measured from a few real notes (partials, body, noise, room), rebuilt for any note
types.sprite: the built-in subtractive synth or drum synth, a designed patch with no real machine behind it
types.physical: a code model designed from the physics, not fitted to a recording
types.designed: a code voice designed by ear, not modeled on a recording

ear_states.passed: the listener could not tell it from the real thing, blind
ear_states.pending: an exam is out or a round is under way, no verdict yet

never_first: showcase.json: the sprite synth presets are never a first sketch ("sounds like a game console")

grand_piano.heard: calibrated from measured notes; no blind exam found. docs/reference.md: closer to real notes than a piano mimic (11.6 vs 16.3 distance), a number, not an ear test

grand_piano_halo.modeled_on: grand piano strings ringing in sympathy

rhodes.heard: samples measured in tune (songs/udio_ab_01/HANDOFF.md, M80); never ear-tested on its own

crackle.modeled_on: vinyl surface noise: clicks and hiss

sfx.modeled_on: one-shot effects: shot, reload, casing, crunch, punch, rip, gong
sfx.range: velocity picks the effect, pitch ignored

placed_audio.modeled_on: the song's own placed audio clips and frozen tracks, played on a live deck
placed_audio.range: pitch and velocity ignored; live_load gives it to audio tracks (audio_place, track_freeze)

transitions.heard: proven in a song (songs/electrohouse, M249a), no ear test
transitions.range: the note picks it: C1 impact, D1 uplifter, E1 downlifter, others reverse crash

eq.what: parametric EQ: peak, shelves, 12/24 dB cuts, notch, bandpass

filter.what: low-, high- and band-pass filter with a tempo LFO

width.what: stereo width, mono below a frequency

compressor.what: compressor with sidechain, sidechain high-pass and parallel mix

duck.what: ducking on another track's notes or every N beats

distortion.what: waveshaper: tanh, hard, fold, asymmetric, rectify, bitcrush, downsample, oversampled

tape.what: tape: saturation, head bump, top loss, wow, flutter, hiss

amp.what: guitar amp: gain, tone stack, supply sag, power-amp breakup, its own hum and hiss

cab.what: speaker cabinet and mic, close to room, cone breakup

wah.what: wah pedal, by hand or by the input envelope

univibe.what: photo-cell phase vibe, chorus or vibrato mode

rotary.what: rotating speaker: horn and drum, speed ramps, doppler

delay.what: delay in beats or ms, ping-pong, filtered feedback

hall.what: synthetic convolution hall: RT60, early reflections

vocoder.what: vocoder: a track or a sound as the modulator

autotune.what: pitch correction to a key and scale or to another track, formant keep

spatial.what: 3D position: HRTF, doppler, occlusion, room, trajectories
